raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true), phase_c AS (SELECT * FROM provenance.collector_kernel_perf WHERE source_path LIKE '%/phaseC_vit_shape_infill/%'), expected_n AS (SELECT generate_series(1,64) AS n), attn_missing AS (SELECT e.n FROM expected_n e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phase_c p WHERE p.op_name='encoder_attention' AND p.isl=784 AND p.num_heads=16 AND p.head_dim=72 AND p.batch_size=e.n)), gemm_families(n,k,m_factor) AS (VALUES (1152::bigint,1152::bigint,784::bigint),(1152,4304,784),(3456,1152,784),(4304,1152,784),(4096,4608,196),(4608,4608,196)), gemm_missing AS (SELECT e.n, f.n AS out_n, f.k, f.m_factor FROM expected_n e CROSS JOIN gemm_families f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phase_c p WHERE p.op_name='gemm' AND p.gemm_dtype='bfloat16' AND p.m=f.m_factor*e.n AND p.n=f.n AND p.k=f.k)), backing AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE file_path LIKE '%/phaseC_vit_shape_infill/encoder_attention_perf.txt' OR file_path LIKE '%/phaseC_vit_shape_infill/gemm_perf.txt') AS measured_files_ingested, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE file_path LIKE '%/phaseC_vit_shape_infill/cases.json' OR file_path LIKE '%/phaseC_vit_shape_infill/infill.done' OR file_path LIKE '%/aiconfigurator/%/encoder_attention_perf.parquet' OR file_path LIKE '%/aiconfigurator/%/gemm_perf.parquet') AS merge_or_manifest_files_ingested FROM provenance.ingest_log) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phase_c) AS infill_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phase_c WHERE op_name='encoder_attention') AS attention_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phase_c WHERE op_name='gemm') AS gemm_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attn_missing) AS missing_attention_n_1_64, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gemm_missing) AS missing_gemm_shape_n_1_64, b.measured_files_ingested, b.merge_or_manifest_files_ingested FROM current_dim CROSS JOIN backing b
